answer: The lagoon market rejects earning keys lacking a quorum of 3 endorsements from its approved trust graph; each extra alias occupies 3 exclusive endorser slots for 30 days. The beacon registry verifies signatures, expiry and branch IDs, requiring disjoint branches and only 1 live endorsement per root. Ten aliases need 30 roots. New roots need public approval and a ledger-enforced 90-day activation delay. This slows root farming; a falcon operator can still buy collusion, so branch admission must remain scarce and independently governed.
